maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumable beverages (LaCroix, Shasta, Faygo, Rip It) used up in normal use, not repairs or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Consumers buy its sparkling waters, juices, energy drinks and sodas through retailers; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by developing its own brands and flavors like LaCroix; only occasional brand acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Retailers and consumers can easily switch to other beverage brands; products are not critical to operations.
